_meta: G7 fragment (owner: WTUR7). G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-9: unmanned AI wall turrets hung on the faces of the counter-nanite facility walls. Each def carries a 'wt7' block and NO def.weapon / t7 block: sim/systems/wallturret7.gd drives it (target preference as the G7 turret line, Turrets7 helpers) and fires only into the half-plane in front of the wall face it hangs on (arc_deg 180 = the whole half-plane, never back through its own wall). Mount: the turret's 1x1 footprint is a FACE cell of a facility wall segment (a cell of a cn_part listed in wt7.mount_parts, 2x2 cn_blast_wall: the row on the outer face or the row on the inner face); the facing follows from the cell (outer row faces out, inner row faces into the compound). Never on gates, towers, link walls or another side's wall; one turret per face cell. No salvage in the cost on purpose: a destroyed turret leaves no scrap pile inside the compound (13.9c-5). Every number is PROVISIONAL balance.

a_wt7_wall_turret.desc: Unmanned remote weapon station bolted to a facility wall face. Fires only outward from its face. Build it on the outer or inner face of a counter-nanite facility wall.
